title: Dame Lark and the Helmets
moral: Working together with kindness makes big tasks easier.

scenes.summary: Dame Lark prepares for the Day of Helmets and begins her task.
scenes.text: Dame Lark woke up in the castle on the Day of Helmets. She was a brave and kind knight. She set out to hang all the helmets in the Great Hall before the sunbell rang.
scenes.image_prompt: female knight in castle preparing helmets morning sunlight colorful cartoon style
scenes.story: Dame Lark woke up in the castle on the Day of Helmets. She was a brave and kind knight. She set out to hang all the helmets in the Great Hall. She met Pip who was nervous, and she helped him feel calm. In the hall, she worked with Pip, Sir Rowan, and her horse Brindle to hang helmets. They solved problems like reaching high pegs and fixing straps. They shared food and helped each other. At last, all helmets were hung in a neat shining line. Everyone felt proud and happy. Dame Lark reminded everyone that helping each other is the knight’s way.

scenes.summary: The task seems difficult with high pegs and many helmets.
scenes.text: In the Great Hall, there were many helmets and some were too high to reach. Pip felt unsure, and the work looked hard.
